_comment: Copy to roster.json. Maps an Apex transponder id (from the 30001-range live feed) to the driver sitting in that kart FOR THE CURRENT SESSION. A transponder is physical hardware and gets reused by a different driver every session, so this is refreshed per session — it is NOT the stable equipment map (see karts.example.json). Edits are picked up live, no restart. The real roster.json is git-ignored: it contains customer names.
